# 2 Baruch Chapter 82 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 82:5 — evil rooted out formula

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "all-evil-will-be-rooted-out, and-all-wickedness-will-be-swept-away" |
| LOGOS | "all evil will be rooted out, and all wickedness will be swept away" |
| PNEUMA | "All evil will be uprooted and all wickedness swept away" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. The Syriac uses two distinct verbs (ittea'kur / nittakpe); 'rooted out' and 'swept away' preserve this lexical distinction. PNEUMA's 'uprooted' and 'swept away' is very close but LOGOS is more precise.

---

## 82:9 — permanence of Jacob's seed

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "the-seed-of-Jacob will-not-be-rooted-out" |
| LOGOS | "the seed of Jacob will not be rooted out" |
| PNEUMA | "the descendants of Jacob will not be cut off" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Rooted out' (Syriac: la nettea'kar) maintains the agricultural metaphor used throughout this eschatological context. PNEUMA's 'cut off' uses a different metaphor.
